en: An old monochrome postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic monastery complex with a church and adjoining convent buildings behind a line of trees and a wall. The church has pointed arches, a tall central spire and decorative gables; crosses are visible on the roofs. Printed text at the bottom identifies the site, and there is cursive handwritten correspondence over the lower part of the image.
